truthReference: Independent hand audit of validation/m12/fixtures/html/*.html against HTML5 semantics and the M11 HTML contract (validated 1.000/1.000 in M11.12): an element becomes a class symbol iff it carries an explicit id or class attribute, named by the id first then the class value; anonymous structural tags (div/span/ul/li/tr/th/head/body/...) are noise, not symbols, and pass their parent's identity through for containment so child symbols chain to the nearest significant ancestor. Relationships: contains = DOM hierarchy between symbols (nearest significant ancestor -> element); uses = external resource references (script src, link href, img src/srcset candidates, audio/video src, source src in picture/audio/video, external anchors href, internal #anchor and label for= resolved to the target element id via idMap); calls = form action (submission target); imports mirror the resource uses (script/link/img/srcset/media/form-action modules). javascript: and empty (#) anchors emit nothing; label for / anchor href with no matching id emit nothing (unresolved). Export list is empty (HTML has no export keyword).
note: M12 per-analyzer differential for html. Precision/recall/fp/fn/unknown computed against independent ground truth. Identity contract: symbol facts keyed by file:line:kind:name; relationship facts keyed by file:type:sourceId:targetId with attributes={type} only (no line, no extra fields) so the comparison measures extraction correctness, not naming noise.
